text_block_list.text: It's unfortunate, but it can't be helped...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of it, besides technique,
the placement of the plushies and the strength of the claw also seem to play a role.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In other words... it is not your fault, Trainer.
Please, do not let it get you down.
It ended in a disappointing result...
